Service Overview AGAT's Pragatix is a security-first AI platform and a suite of enterprise AI services that enables organizations to adopt generative AI with full governance and data privacy control, supporting both on-premises deployment and controlled use of public AI services. The AI Security Suite provides three protection layers - Prompt Guardian, Guardian Agent, and Model Guardian. It enables risk-based policy enforcement, data classification, and visibility into enterprise and shadow AI usage, while protecting against threats such as prompt injection and data leakage. The Private AI Suite is an end-to-end enterprise-ready AI platform deployable in air-gapped, private cloud, or SaaS environments.
